field_contract.time_interval: exact accepted interval identity from the admitted time model; no epsilon/tolerance semantics are introduced here
field_contract.element: water, N, P, or C. C is admitted only for a pool with an explicit qualified conversion; MASSQ02 natural C evidence is soil-organic-C only via Cfracom
field_contract.species_pool: physical species or pool being transferred
field_contract.amount: non-negative scalar transfer magnitude; direction is encoded only by source_owner and destination_owner
field_contract.unit: explicit amount unit per ground area; presentation conversions such as kg/ha are projections only
field_contract.source_owner: exact physical owner or external boundary sentinel
field_contract.destination_owner: exact physical owner or external boundary sentinel
field_contract.internal_external: derived from owner membership in the declared ANIMO system boundary
field_contract.process: source process that caused the transfer
field_contract.evidence_coordinate: source routine/state/transfer coordinate or qualified synthetic evidence coordinate

owner_rules.internal_event: source and destination are both internal owners
owner_rules.external_event: exactly one of source or destination is an internal owner
owner_rules.invalid_event: both owners are external, source equals destination, negative amount, or missing evidence coordinate
owner_rules.control_volume_projection: an intrinsically internal event may appear as a boundary term for a narrower observer control volume, e.g. soil-to-crop uptake for a soil-only volume. The event itself is not duplicated or retyped.

conservation_proof.owner_delta_definition: for one event, source owner delta = -amount and destination owner delta = +amount
conservation_proof.internal_combined_control_volume: if both owners are included, (-amount)+(+amount)=0 exactly. No tolerance is part of this identity.
conservation_proof.external_boundary_crossing: XOR(internal(source_owner), internal(destination_owner)) must be true, therefore exactly one system boundary crossing exists.
conservation_proof.interface_rule: one physical transfer creates one event edge. Two independently signed layer records are forbidden because they could double count an internal interface.
conservation_proof.legacy_balance_accumulator_dependency: none; event amount must originate from process transfer/state coordinates, not Bawa/Banh/Bani/Bano/Bapp/Bapo accumulators

event_types.unit: m water per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-WATER-PROFILE; Input_hydro/Hydro_detailed; EVSO/EVPN/EVICPR/EVICIRR/EVSN/FLEV

event_types.unit: m water per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-WATER-PROFILE; RU/FLK/FLS/FLG/FLD/FLD2/FLAB bottom boundary
event_types.amount_rule: non-negative accepted-interval flux amount after direction resolution

event_types.unit: m water per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-INTERNAL-INTERFACE-CANCEL; FLAB interface fluxes
event_types.amount_rule: one event per physical interface; reverse owners when flux direction reverses

event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-SOLUTE-LAYER/ID-SOLUTE-PROFILE; TRANSPORT.FOR/Transgen.for Toin/Toou
event_types.amount_rule: single edge sourced from the physical interface transfer; do not emit independent signed copies for both layers

event_types.evidence_coordinate: BOUNDARY input variables plus PREP06 ID-SOLUTE-PROFILE; TRANSPORT/Transgen boundary transfer terms
event_types.amount_rule: one event for each source boundary/species transfer actually realized in the accepted interval

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-SOLUTE-PROFILE; TRANSPORT/Transgen Toou and pathway-specific drainage/export transfers
event_types.amount_rule: one event per system-boundary crossing; internal layer transport is excluded

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-MATERIAL-ADDITION; Addit; QUMT with FROR/FRNH/FRNI/FRPO/FR/FRCA and N/P pool fractions
event_types.amount_rule: material composition is expanded into species-specific non-negative transfers; no legacy balance accumulator is an amount source

event_types.unit: kg N per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-MATERIAL-ADDITION; Addit FRVO branch
event_types.amount_rule: explicit external-loss component of the material-addition identity

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 conserved-state mapping; layer-0/top-reservoir transport in TRANSPORT/Transgen
event_types.amount_rule: internal only when destination remains inside ANIMO system; external when released across runoff/system boundary

event_types.unit: kg N per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-CROP-N; Upintg_Plant.for:54-64; Upintg_Grass.for:49-62; Upintg_Extern.for:48-54; actual Upni transfer and Rsamplni_act state gain
event_types.amount_rule: use realized uptake from the process transfer, never requested/potential uptake or a soil-only balance sink

event_types.unit: kg P per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-CROP-P; Upintg_Plant/Grass/Extern actual P uptake and Rsamplpo_act state gain
event_types.amount_rule: same realized amount debits soil and credits crop in the combined soil+crop control volume

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-CROP-RESIDUE; crop-loss/root-death transfer into material/organic stores
event_types.amount_rule: one owner-to-owner event for the returned fraction; composition determines element-specific companion events

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-CROP-HARVEST; crop state loss minus explicitly returned residue fraction
event_types.amount_rule: external remainder is derived from crop-state loss and explicit residue return, not from a soil-only balance accumulator

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-CROP-GRAZING; crop state loss and Osgr-return semantics
event_types.amount_rule: external consumed remainder unless a separate management return event explicitly re-enters the system

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-REDISTRIBUTION; Addit redistribution state transfers; TCD-017 reporting seam remains visible
event_types.amount_rule: one physical transfer per source/destination pair; public Bapo(Redi) is not an authoritative amount source

event_types.unit: kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-ORG-TRANSFORM / ID-N-MINERALIZATION / ID-P-MINERALIZATION; Resp_miner transfer variables
event_types.amount_rule: species-specific amount follows the source process transfer; C events require an explicit qualified carbon conversion for the participating pool

event_types.unit: kg N per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-NITRIFICATION; process source/sink terms feeding TRANSPORT
event_types.amount_rule: non-GHG core projection only; any N2O split requires active qualified GHG event topology

event_types.unit: kg N per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-DENITRIFICATION; Denitr and process terms feeding nitrate transport
event_types.amount_rule: core external N loss may be projected where source transfer is explicit; detailed N2/N2O split remains feature-scoped

event_types.unit: kg P per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-P-SORPTION; Transgen/Transorp state deltas Rscopo/Rsamcxfa/Rsamcxsl/Rsampopr; TCD-019 remains visible
event_types.amount_rule: single phase-transfer edge; numerical/storage inconsistency is a residual, never corrected by ledger projection

event_types.unit: m water or kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 ID-MACROPORE-WATER / ID-MACROPORE-SOLUTE; MAPOHYDRO/MAPOTRANSPORT; MP02 synthetic B1 only
event_types.amount_rule: source/destination reverse with physical exchange direction; no natural active case in frozen testbank

event_types.unit: m water or kg element per m2 ground area
event_types.evidence_coordinate: PREP06 specialized MAPOHYDRO/MAPOTRANSPORT identities; MP02 synthetic B1; TCD-025 public-ledger gap
event_types.amount_rule: exactly one boundary crossing; main legacy Dra4/public balance arrays are not authoritative physical state

nested_crop_projection.soil_plus_crop_rule: realized uptake is one internal event from soil nutrient owner to crop nutrient owner; the same amount debits soil and credits Rsamplni_act/Rsamplpo_act through the active uptake route
nested_crop_projection.soil_only_rule: the same event projects as an external sink from a soil-only observer volume without changing the underlying event
nested_crop_projection.external_crop_forcing_rule: for CropUptakeModel=1, requested external forcing is not itself a physical mass crossing. Only realized Upintg_Extern uptake becomes a soil-to-crop transfer.
nested_crop_projection.runtime_event_journal: not yet implemented; MASSQ02 qualifies the source-to-event projection and owner algebra, not a canonical production journal

feature_readiness.core_water_N_P: candidate projection source-qualified and B1 natural observer coverage present
feature_readiness.crop_nested_owner: candidate source-qualified; both internal and externally-forced uptake routes naturally executed
feature_readiness.macropore: synthetic MP02 only; TCD-025 remains visible; no natural feature admission
feature_readiness.GHG: fail-closed incomplete; no compatible natural active B1 case and no MASSQ02 event admission
feature_readiness.carbon: soil-organic-C projection only where Cfracom is explicit; whole-system elemental-C closure is not claimed
